entries.scope: Explicit, side-effect-bounded Home Runtime synchronization inside the ABS-DD sandbox
entries.rationale: Learners and maintainers need the new runtime-only command contract, its container exception, conflict behavior, and Git side-effect boundary at every public reader path.
entries.navigationImpact: Existing README and architecture links remain stable; the command contract is added to those established reader paths.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with complete English companion text in the paired architecture document and bilingual command documentation
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Bash and PowerShell CLI tests use isolated temporary Home directories and verify runtime selection, read-only preview modes, conflict handling, idempotency, and absence of Git side effects.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Any change to the Home Sync manifest, ABS-DD container guard, RuntimeOnly options, conflict policy, or persistent agent-volume layout.
